title: some / any
grammarTitle: some / any — количество без точного числа
grammarNote:
"Some" и "any" — это слова-количители (quantifiers). Они стоят перед существительными и означают "какое-то количество" — не точное число, а просто "немного", "несколько", "какой-то".

Посмотри, как мы уже использовали их в столовой ЗКУ им. М. Утемісова:
"There is some soup." → Есть суп (какое-то количество).
"I don't want any meat." → Я не хочу никакого мяса.
"Is there any compote?" → Есть ли компот?
"Would you like some tea?" → Хотите чаю?

Четыре главных правила:

① SOME → утвердительные предложения (+)
   "There is some bread." · "I have some money." · "There are some baursaks."

② ANY → отрицательные предложения (–)
   "There isn't any meat." · "I don't have any money." · "There aren't any apples."

③ ANY → вопросы (?)
   "Is there any soup?" · "Do you want any tea?" · "Are there any salads?"

④ SOME → в вопросах-предложениях (offers) и вежливых просьбах
   "Would you like some compote?" · "Can I have some bread, please?" · "Shall I get some water?"

💡 Запомни: SOME = ты ЗНАЕШЬ, что что-то есть. ANY = ты НЕ ЗНАЕШЬ или ОТРИЦАЕШЬ.

grammarExtra.title: SOME — подробно: когда и как использовать

rows.example: "There is some rice." · "There are some baursaks on the table."

rows.form: I have / I want / I need some + noun
rows.example: "I have some money." · "I want some soup." · "I need some water."
"some bread" · "some soup" · "some rice" · "some milk" · "some tea"
"some apples" · "some baursaks" · "some students" · "some eggs"
"Would you like SOME tea?" (предлагаю) ≠ "Do you want ANY tea?" (спрашиваю)

rows.form: Can I have some...? / Shall I get some...?
rows.example: "Can I have some bread, please?" · "Shall I get some compote for you?"

grammarExtra.title: ANY — подробно: когда и как использовать

rows.example: "There isn't any meat today." · "There aren't any chips on the menu."

rows.form: I don't have / don't want any + noun
rows.example: "I don't have any money." · "I don't want any spicy food."

rows.form: Вопрос: is there / are there any + noun?
rows.example: "Is there any bread?" · "Are there any vegetarian options today?"

rows.form: Do you have / want any + noun?
rows.example: "Do you have any compote?" · "Do you want any more soup?"
❌ "I have any money." → ✅ "I have some money." (any только в – и ?)
"I don't want any meat." = "Я не хочу никакого мяса."

grammarExtra.title: some / any с исчисляемыми и неисчисляемыми существительными

rows.example: some water / any water · some rice / any rice · some bread / any bread
some apples / any apples · some baursaks / any baursaks · some eggs / any eggs

rows.form: ⚠️ НЕ используй с исч. ед. ч.!
rows.example: ❌ "some apple" → ✅ "some apples" / "an apple" · ❌ "any egg" → ✅ "any eggs" / "an egg"

rows.form: Сравни: some soup (жидкость, ед.ч.) vs some baursaks (штуки, мн.ч.)
rows.example: "There is some soup." · "There are some baursaks." — глагол тоже меняется!
"Someone is in the cafeteria." · "Is there anyone here?" · "I don't know anyone."
"I want something to eat." · "Is there anything vegetarian?" · "I don't want anything."
"Let's sit somewhere quiet." · "Is there anywhere to sit?" · "I don't want to go anywhere."
some– → утверждение / предложение. any– → отрицание / вопрос.

grammarTip:
Самый простой способ запомнить some / any:

✅ SOME = "Есть! Я знаю, что есть."
   → Утверждение + Предложение/просьба
   "There is SOME soup." · "Would you like SOME tea?"

❌ ANY = "Нет? Есть ли? Не уверен."
   → Отрицание + Вопрос
   "There isn't ANY meat." · "Is there ANY bread?"

💡 Лайфхак — переведи на русский:
Если можешь сказать "какой-нибудь / немного" → some
Если говоришь "никакого / есть ли" → any

⚠️ Запомни исключение:
"Would you like SOME tea?" — это предложение (offer), поэтому SOME, а не any!
"Can I have SOME soup?" — это вежливая просьба → SOME!

exercises.text: There is ___ chicken soup on the menu today.
exercises.hint: Positive sentence (+) → some. "There is SOME chicken soup."

exercises.text: I don't want ___ spicy food today — it upsets my stomach.
exercises.hint: Negative sentence (don't) → any. "I don't want ANY spicy food."

exercises.text: Is there ___ compote left? I really want some!
exercises.hint: Question (?) → any. "Is there ANY compote left?"

exercises.text: "I have any money — let me buy lunch" is correct English.
exercises.hint: Positive sentence → some! "I have SOME money." ANY is only for negatives and questions.

exercises.instruction: This is an offer. Choose some or any.
exercises.text: Would you like ___ fresh baursaks? They are still warm!
exercises.hint: Offer / Would you like...? → SOME. "Would you like SOME baursaks?"

exercises.text: There aren't ___ vegetarian options today — only meat dishes.
exercises.hint: Negative (aren't) → any. "There aren't ANY vegetarian options."

There aren't some chips on the menu.
exercises.hint: "Do you have ANY water?" ✅ — question → any. Others misuse some/any.

exercises.text: "Is there something to eat here?" is correct English.
exercises.hint: "Something" = any– compound in a question. Actually here it's some– (you expect the answer yes). Both "something" and "anything" can work in questions, but "something" implies you expect food to be there.
